dataset_meanings.source_documents: Public evidence provenance, including original URLs, checksums, and capture dates.
dataset_meanings.drugs: 46 distinct products in FDA CDER novel drug approvals for calendar year 2025.
dataset_meanings.approval_events: 46 original US FDA CDER approval events; not all FDA actions or global approvals.
dataset_meanings.trials: One published original-approval trial evidence subset, not a complete trial registry.
dataset_meanings.trial_cohorts: Two disjoint prior-treatment cohorts in the selected 105-person efficacy population.
dataset_meanings.trial_results: Four published endpoint percentages, with explicit cohort and endpoint denominators.
dataset_meanings.trial_demographics: Eleven aggregate demographic categories across four overlapping dimensions; no individual patient records.
dataset_meanings.industry_observations: Five regional chart shares for sales of new medicines launched during 2020-2024.

glossary_terms.definition: An original FDA CDER approval event in the bounded 2025 list; not an NDC listing.
The 105-person original-approval efficacy subset, not every participant in the trial.
Published response percentage in one cohort; denominator is 71 or 34 patients.
Observed response duration among responders; denominators are 53 and 15.
Regional share for the chart-defined 2020-2024 launch cohort, not total drug-market share.

curation_method: Deterministic FDA HTML table extraction plus explicit curation of trial facts and visually checked EFPIA page 4 chart. No AI/OCR extraction is claimed.
